title: 2024 Topps Update Chrome Kyle Harrison Rookie Debut (RC) #USC157 SF Giants
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2024 Topps Chrome baseball trading card featuring rookie player Kyle Harrison from the San Francisco Giants. The card, numbered USC 157, is part of the 2024 Topps Update Chrome set manufactured by Topps. It is a valuable collectible for fans and collectors of sports trading cards, especially those interested in up-and-coming players like Harrison. This card would be a great addition to any baseball card collection, showcasing a promising new talent in the sport.
